# 74100 - 8-bit bistable latches

Package DIP-24 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74100.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74100.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 23 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74100 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74100.png) | ![74100 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74100.png) | ![74100 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74100.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 1Q1 = state1Q1 | Latch 1Q1: follows 1D1 while 1G is high, holds while 1G is low. |
| 4 | 1Q2 = state1Q2 | Latch 1Q2: follows 1D2 while 1G is high, holds while 1G is low. |
| 19 | 1Q3 = state1Q3 | Latch 1Q3: follows 1D3 while 1G is high, holds while 1G is low. |
| 20 | 1Q4 = state1Q4 | Latch 1Q4: follows 1D4 while 1G is high, holds while 1G is low. |
| 8 | 2Q1 = state2Q1 | Latch 2Q1: follows 2D1 while 2G is high, holds while 2G is low. |
| 9 | 2Q2 = state2Q2 | Latch 2Q2: follows 2D2 while 2G is high, holds while 2G is low. |
| 18 | 2Q3 = state2Q3 | Latch 2Q3: follows 2D3 while 2G is high, holds while 2G is low. |
| 17 | 2Q4 = state2Q4 | Latch 2Q4: follows 2D4 while 2G is high, holds while 2G is low. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: level of 1G (latches 1Q1-1Q4) and 2G (latches 2Q1-2Q4)

- G high: Q = D (transparent)
- G low: Q holds the level it had before the high-to-low transition of G

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D | Q | PLH | 16 | 30 |
| D | Q | PHL | 14 | 25 |
| G | Q | PLH | 16 | 30 |
| G | Q | PHL | 7 | 15 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns |
|---|---|---|---|
| pulse width high | 1G,2G |  | 20 |
| setup | D | G high-to-low | 20 |
| hold | D | G high-to-low | 5 |

## Notes

Only the Q outputs are brought out to pins; the function table also lists Q-bar, which is internal. Two independent 4-bit latches, each with its own enable. The table gives setup and hold without naming the edge; the high-to-low transition of G is where the function table says the data is kept. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
